## EMNLP 2026 ARR Submission Deadline

**The EMNLP 2026 ARR submission deadline is May 25, 2026**, which matches the date you mentioned. This was officially announced by EMNLP 2026, with the deadline set to 11:59 PM UTC-12:00 ("anywhere on Earth").

## Related ACL Rolling Review Deadlines

For the general ACL Rolling Review process in May 2026:
- **ARR Submission Deadline: May 15, 2026** (standard submission deadline for the rolling review platform)
- However, **for EMNLP 2026 specifically, the deadline is May 25, 2026**

The May 25, 2026 deadline for EMNLP 2026 also applies to AACL 2026 (AACL-IJCNLP 2026), which will be held in Hengqin, China from November 6-10, 2026.

After submission, important follow-up deadlines include:
- **Author Registration: May 27, 2026** (all authors must complete registration)
- **Review Completion: July 6, 2026** (if assigned reviews)
- **Meta-review Deadline: July 29, 2026**
